name: Life Is Not a Game
overview: A shy teen gamer has secretly posed as a boy online for years, forming a deep bond with her teammate Jupiter, who turns out to be TJ, the popular jock she secretly likes at school. When their esports team earns a shot at a live tournament, her hidden identity unravels, putting her friendships, her team, and her first love at risk. Now she must choose between the safety of the persona that protected her and the truth that could cost her everything.
